abstract: Benign teratoma, also referred as dermoid cyst, do occur in the mediastinum. However, their intrapericardial location has been reported very occasionally. This case of intrapericardial benign solid teratoma is being presented because of its rarity and its unusual presentation as a case of empyema, with features of cardiac compression and pericardial effusion.
abstract_ja: 良性奇形腫（類皮嚢腫とも呼ばれる）は縦隔に生じうる。しかし心膜内での発生は非常にまれにしか報告されていない。膿胸として提示し、心臓圧迫の所見と心膜液貯留を伴った、この心膜内良性充実性奇形腫の症例を、その希少性と非典型的な提示のため報告する。
